role.title: Cybersecurity Engineer
role.focus: Application, network and infrastructure security, threat modeling, detection and secure engineering
role.objective: Build, ship, test and maintain reliable production-grade systems in this specialization.

responsibilities.1: Design and implement application, network and infrastructure security, threat modeling, detection and secure engineering.
responsibilities.2: Translate requirements into maintainable technical solutions.
responsibilities.3: Write clean, modular and testable code.
responsibilities.4: Work with databases, APIs and production infrastructure relevant to the role.
responsibilities.5: Debug failures using logs, metrics and systematic root-cause analysis.
responsibilities.6: Use Git and collaborative development practices.
responsibilities.7: Automate repetitive engineering and deployment workflows.
responsibilities.8: Apply security, reliability and performance best practices.
responsibilities.9: Document architecture, decisions and operational procedures.
responsibilities.10: Deploy solutions and monitor them in realistic environments.
responsibilities.11: Measure quality and improve systems based on evidence.
responsibilities.12: Collaborate with engineers, product stakeholders and data teams.

qualifications.education: Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, Data or related field; strong equivalent self-learning is acceptable.
qualifications.experience: Projects, internships, open-source contributions or practical engineering work.
qualifications.portfolio: At least 2 substantial projects with documented technical decisions and a deployed or reproducible implementation.

interview_questions.22: How do you prevent SQL injection?
interview_questions.43: How do you investigate suspicious logs?
interview_questions.44: How do you respond to credential compromise?
interview_questions.45: How do you secure an API?
interview_questions.46: How do you secure cloud workloads?
interview_questions.47: How would you perform a web application threat model?
interview_questions.48: How would you design network segmentation?
interview_questions.49: How would you investigate a suspected breach?
interview_questions.50: Design a secure web application architecture.

1.name: Secure Web Application Lab
1.description: Build a deliberately vulnerable training application, identify OWASP risks, then implement secure fixes with automated security tests and documentation.

2.name: Security Monitoring Pipeline
2.description: Collect application and system logs, normalize events, detect suspicious patterns and create alert workflows with an investigation dashboard.

3.name: API Security Gateway
3.description: Build an API gateway with authentication, authorization, rate limiting, validation, audit logging and security monitoring.
